emergency.title: Someone badly hurt?
emergency.aidersUnknown: The first aiders’ names come with the network. Call your team leader.
emergency.aidersNone: No first aider is on record for this site. Call your team leader.
emergency.asOf: First aiders as read on this tablet at {time}
emergency.helpOneTap: One tap sends the call. It works without the network too.
emergency.helpRefused: The call for help was not taken: {call}

helpOpen.SENT: Help is called: {call}. Nobody has seen it yet.
helpOpen.SEEN: Help is called: {call}. Someone has seen it.
helpOpen.ON_THE_WAY: Help is called: {call}. Someone is on the way.

what.title: What happened?
what.offline: No network: a report with your name is saved on this tablet and goes when the network is back.

hint.NEAR_MISS: Nobody hurt, but it nearly happened

where.title: Where?
where.elsewhereHint: Say where in a few words
where.placeHint: A few words: the place, a door, a rack.
where.noStation: This tablet is not at a station: pick an area, or say where in a few words.
where.planLater: A plan of the site to tap on comes in a later version.
where.asOf: Areas and machines as read on this tablet at {time}

people.title: Who was hurt or there? (optional)
people.hint: Name the people. What the injury is, the office asks and records.
people.outsideHint: A visitor, a driver, a contractor. Their name only.

photo.title: A photo of the place
photo.noFaces: No faces: take the place or the thing, never a person.
photo.afterSend: The photos go up once the office has the report.
photo.waitReport: Keep this screen open until the photos are added.
photo.dropped: The photos taken with it were not sent.
photo.window: Up to {count} photos, within {minutes} minutes of the report. Later the office adds them.

name.title: Your name
name.notStored: Your name is not stored with this report.
name.online: It goes at once and is never kept on this tablet.
name.offline: No network: it waits on this screen, never on the tablet, and goes when the network is back.
name.withName: With your name, safety can ask you what they need.
name.injury: An injury is reported with your name: safety needs to know who saw it.

send.now: Sent at once, without your name
send.waits: Without your name: it waits on this screen for the network
send.saves: Saved on this tablet first, then sent
send.savesOffline: No network: saved on this tablet, sent later

sent.title: Report sent
sent.waits: No network: it goes as soon as the network is back. Nothing is lost.
sent.refusedFix: Tell your team leader now, or report it again.

seen.title: Seen by safety
seen.notYet: Not seen yet. This screen says it when safety opens it.
seen.afterSend: Safety sees it once it is sent.

waiting.title: Not sent yet
waiting.offlineBody: There is no network. A report without your name is sent only online.
waiting.unavailableBody: The office does not answer. It tries again by itself.
waiting.neverKept: It waits on this screen, never on the tablet, and goes by itself when it can. Keep this screen open.
waiting.withNameHint: With your name it is saved on this tablet at once and goes when the network is back.

held.place: Say where in a few words
held.photoOffline: A photo needs the network. The report itself still saves on this tablet.
held.photosFull: Four photos at most from the tablet; the office adds more
held.photoWindow: More than 30 minutes since the report: the office adds photos now
held.peopleFull: Twenty people at most in one report
held.meAdded: You are in the report already
held.noRoster: This tablet has no list of names: add them as someone from outside, or the office adds them
held.personAdded: This person is in the report already

problem.offline: No network. Try again when it is back.
problem.unavailable: The office does not answer. Try again in a moment.
problem.forbidden: You may not send this report from this tablet. Tell your team leader.
problem.notFound: This report is not found on this tablet.
problem.invalid: The report was not taken as sent. Check it and try again.
problem.signedOut: You are signed out. Sign in again.
problem.rateLimited: Too many tries. Wait a moment.

refusal.ANONYMOUS_INJURY: An injury is reported with a name: only a near miss or a hazard may go without one.
refusal.ANONYMOUS_NAMES_NOBODY: A report without your name names nobody: leave the people out, or send it with your name.
refusal.ANONYMOUS_NOT_QUEUED: A report without your name is never kept on the tablet: send it when the network is back.
refusal.WHERE_MISSING: Say where it happened: here, an area, a machine or a few words.
refusal.WHERE_OTHER_SITE: That place is not at this site: pick one of this site's.
refusal.OCCURRED_IN_FUTURE: The tablet's clock is ahead: tell your team leader.
refusal.INJURED_NOT_INJURY: Someone hurt goes in an incident: pick Incident (someone hurt), or mark them as there.
refusal.PERSON_TWICE: A person is in the report twice: remove one.
refusal.PHOTOS_FULL: Four photos at most from the tablet; the office adds more.
refusal.PHOTO_WINDOW: More than 30 minutes since the report: the office adds photos now.
refusal.NOT_OPEN: Safety has closed or cancelled this report: it takes no more photos.
